svg.aria-label: Lines of pull: external rotation, internal rotation and abduction — 力线与外旋、内旋、外展; origin and insertion attachment map — 起止点附着图

text.aria-label: Superior view: right humeral head — 俯视右肱骨头
Posterior — 后
Anterior — 前
Lateral — 外
Medial · Scapula — 内 · 肩胛骨
Long axis — 长轴
Greater tubercle — 大结节
Lesser tubercle — 小结节
Infraspinatus + Teres minor: posterior pull — 冈下肌、小圆肌往后拉
Subscapularis: anteromedial pull — 肩胛下肌往前内拉
→ External rotation — → 外旋
→ Internal rotation — → 内旋
Posterior view: anteroposterior axis — 右肩后面观：前后方向的轴
text.tspan: 右肩后面观：前后方向的轴

text.aria-label: Axis — 轴
Supraspinatus: pull above the axis — 冈上肌：从轴的上方拉过
text.tspan: 冈上肌：从轴的上方拉过

text.aria-label: → Abduction — → 外展
Middle Deltoid above the axis → Abduction — 三角肌中束在轴上方 → 外展
text.tspan: Middle Deltoid above the axis → Abduction
三角肌中束在轴上方 → 外展

text.aria-label: Inferior fibers of Infraspinatus, Teres minor and Subscapularis depress the humeral head — 冈下肌、小圆肌、肩胛下肌的下部纤维把肱骨头往下压
text.tspan: Inferior fibers of Infraspinatus, Teres minor and Subscapularis depress the humeral head

text.aria-label: Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Dashed arrows: attachment direction. Solid arrows above: force / motion. — 虚线：附着走向；上方实线箭头：力或运动。
text.tspan: Dashed arrows: attachment direction. Solid arrows above: force / motion.

text.aria-label: Supraspinatus — 冈上肌
O Supraspinous fossa of scapula — 肩胛骨冈上窝
I Superior facet of greater tubercle of humerus — 肱骨大结节上小面
text.tspan: I Superior facet of greater tubercle of humerus

text.aria-label: Infraspinatus — 冈下肌
O Infraspinous fossa of scapula — 肩胛骨冈下窝
I Middle facet of greater tubercle of humerus — 肱骨大结节中小面
text.tspan: I Middle facet of greater tubercle of humerus

text.aria-label: Teres minor — 小圆肌
O Lateral border of scapula — 肩胛骨外侧缘
I Inferior facet of greater tubercle of humerus — 肱骨大结节下小面
text.tspan: I Inferior facet of greater tubercle of humerus

text.aria-label: Subscapularis — 肩胛下肌
O Subscapular fossa of scapula — 肩胛骨肩胛下窝
I Lesser tubercle of humerus — 肱骨小结节
Middle Deltoid — 三角肌中束
O Lateral acromion — 肩峰外侧
I Deltoid tuberosity of humerus — 肱骨三角肌粗隆
Scapular origins lie outside this humeral-head view. — 肩胛骨起点位于这幅肱骨头视图之外。
